title: Grow typo-RAM em9305_ram_801a04 to 16 bytes and retarget 32bdfc field access: source fix for -Werror=array-bounds, QEMU-ARC prove, private tree p-lowers with no --extra, NVM slot-fit, private NOR splice, paired Renode sims
scope: em9305 leftover typo-RAM C. After the closed sources.json -I insert, grow em9305_ram_801a04 from the harvested 1-byte object to the 16-byte out-buffer used by leftover C (32e144 write / 32bdfc read), switch init_native_child_32bdfc.c to in-bounds typo-RAM word fields, rebuild from the tree without private --extra or -Wno-error=array-bounds, prove the affected function, package, both paired sims.

stock_check.result: 16 bytes at 0x801a04 fit exactly and are what leftover C uses
stock_check.writer: init_native_child_32e144.c packs two 6-byte addresses into four uint32 words at the caller-supplied out pointer (stores at out+0,+4,+8,+12; returns 12, the packed-address length, not the buffer size)
stock_check.reader: init_native_child_32bdfc.c is the only HEAD / tree user of 0x801a04; it calls 32e144(0x801a04, pdu+2) and reads parsed[0..3] (stock) from that buffer
stock_check.head_literals: git grep of HEAD found 0x801a04 only in 32bdfc; no independent literals at 0x801a08, 0x801a0c, or 0x801a10. 0x801a00 uses sit in em9305_ram_8019e8. Next typo-RAM object is em9305_ram_801a14 at 0x801a14
stock_check.neighbor_placement: sizeof(struct em9305_ram_8019e8)==28 so it ends at 0x801a04; grown sizeof(struct em9305_ram_801a04)==16 ends at 0x801a14; no overlap (host gcc -std=c11)
stock_check.harvest_gap: widen plan.json added[61] recorded base 0x00801a04 end 0x00801a05 size 1 (literal harvest missed the out-parameter extent)
stock_check.ld: g2-em9305.ld only assigns absolute symbol addresses (em9305_ram_801a04 = 0x00801a04). Growing sizeof does not change the symbol address. Header objects are extern with a section attribute to keep them out of gp small-data; the linker script provides the addresses. ld was not rewritten and remains sha256 6f89db8801e136608cb98afbdeee3b9860d6f2ccbbeef1ff3148b4f51f1d4ccb

source_fix.array_bounds: Fixed in source. No -Wno-error=array-bounds on this rebuild. gcc -Werror=array-bounds fired because em9305_ram_801a04 was a 1-byte object while 32bdfc indexed a 16-byte view. The object is now 16 bytes and 32bdfc reads u32_801a04/u32_801a08/u32_801a0c/u32_801a10
source_fix.em9305_ram_801a04: four u32/u8 unions at +0,+4,+8,+0xc plus offsetof asserts and _Static_assert(sizeof==16). Targeted text replace of the old 1-byte struct only; no full header re-serialize
source_fix.sources_json_note: The earlier approved targeted -I insert (profiles g2-em9305-1 and g2-em9305-2) is already in the tree; approval is closed. This pass did not write sources.json.

prove.orig: git HEAD stock leftover C (literals at 0x801a04) saved as build/ws-em9305-20261122/lowers/prove/orig_32bdfc.c
prove.cand: tree init_native_child_32bdfc.c after typo-RAM field access
prove.vacuous_default_stubs: A first run against the shared chunks/spec.json and default auto-stubs was EQUIVALENT 100 but only ncalls=1 (32db0c stub, then the LLID/opcode gates fail). That does not exercise the typo-RAM word copies. Not used as the proof.

forced_path.extra: build/ws-em9305-20261122/lowers/prove/extra_32bdfc.c (test-only: 32db0c forces llid=3 opcode=12; real 32e144 pack-into-out body; 30301c stub_hit-observes the 20-byte request). Shared extra_cb1.c and chunks/spec.json were not modified
forced_path.private_spec: build/ws-em9305-20261122/lowers/prove/spec_32bdfc.json lists those helpers under real so qm.py objcopy -N strips them from stubs.o (unit symbols are --weaken-symbols, so unstripped stubs would otherwise win)

forced_path.mutant_wrong_word0: request.words[0] reads u32_801a08 instead of u32_801a04: MISMATCH callhash:100(t=[0, 1, 2])  classes=93 calls=400  log mut_32bdfc_wrong_word0_real.log
forced_path.mutant_drop_word3: drops request.words[3]=u32_801a10: MISMATCH callhash:100(t=[0, 1, 2])  classes=93 calls=400  log mut_32bdfc_drop_word3_real.log

prove.32e144: Not itself a typo-RAM unit (generic out pointer). Unchanged this pass; exercised as a real helper inside the 32bdfc prove.

tree_build.tool: build/ws-em9305-20261122/pbuild.py (default --ld is the tree linker script)
tree_build.extra_note: No --extra. Include path comes from sources.json profile flags. No -Wno-error=array-bounds. All 768 units recompiled after the header growth (cache key includes the header).

slot_fit.note: Fit is against the EM9305 main NVM window 0x00300000..0x00380000 and the official record2 ASSERTs (bootloader must not reach 0x00302000; app must not pass 0x00380000). Precomputed programmed-NVM CRCs of our record extents: [0x00300000,0x00300488)=1D6121C4, [0x00302000,0x00302038)=D0CFF430, [0x00302400,0x0033CB94)=DEEF4351.

splice.private_g2_app_note: Byte-identical private copy of official opencfw-otap-disarm.app.bin. Official file was not opened for write. Host app was left unchanged this turn.
splice.nor_source: copy of build/em9305-nor-20261122/nor-stock-formatted.bin, then lfs_inject at 0x1400000 path /firmware/ble_em9305.bin

compare.version_match_vs: prior lowers-match and widen-match (same CHIPREV 0x22, OTAP 0xAFD1363A then 0, HOST 0x3A, END_PC 0x543528, 2 display frames, display hash 0c5cc90b…, 56 HCI host packets)
compare.verdict: Version-match is a full baseline pass versus the 7:54 PM CST widen-install run and the 10:32 PM CST pre-growth lowers run. Forced-mismatch DFU completed the known handshake (commit 00020404, SYSRESETREQ at 10:54:31.645 PM CST, SBL app handoff, display hash, HOST 0x3A after handoff). Record2/app CRC windows and DFU HCI counts differ from the pre-growth lowers image, as required by splicing the new 3-record package (app 239508 B, 100 B smaller). Observed record CRCs equal the precomputed slot-fit digests. Bootloader CRC 1D6121C4 is unchanged. DFU HCI host packets are 1038 versus 1039 on the pre-growth 239608 B image.
